source_question: Green Field: Expanding Fiber Coverage to Acquire New FBB and FMC Subscribers
core: Expand fiber coverage in greenfield areas to acquire new FBB and FMC subscribers.
meaning_cn: 在绿区扩大光纤覆盖，以获取新的固定宽带和融合业务用户。
explanation_cn: greenfield 通常写作一个词，作形容词修饰 areas，表示尚未建设或缺少现有网络覆盖的新增建设区域。expand fiber coverage in... 表示在某类区域扩大光纤覆盖；acquire new subscribers 是电信商业汇报中常见的用户获取表达。PPT 标题可写为：Expand Fiber Coverage in Greenfield Areas to Acquire New FBB and FMC Subscribers。
source_sentence: Green Field: Expanding Fiber Coverage to Acquire New FBB and FMC Subscribers

examples.en: Expand fiber coverage in greenfield areas to acquire new FBB and FMC subscribers.
examples.cn: 在绿区扩大光纤覆盖，以获取新的固定宽带和融合业务用户。

examples.en: Greenfield expansion can open new sources of subscriber growth.
examples.cn: 绿区扩张可以开辟新的用户增长来源。

examples.en: Prioritize greenfield areas with strong demand and limited existing coverage.
examples.cn: 优先考虑需求强劲且现有覆盖有限的绿区。

pronunciation.text: Expand fiber coverage in greenfield areas to acquire new FBB and FMC subscribers.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 expand、fiber coverage、greenfield areas、acquire、FBB、FMC 和 subscribers；FBB 与 FMC 逐字母读。

source_question: OLT分布式部署，复用无线站点与上行光纤，可降低HP成本
core: Distributed OLT deployment can reuse mobile sites and uplink fiber, reducing the cost per home passed.
meaning_cn: 分布式 OLT 部署可以复用移动站点和上行光纤，从而降低每户覆盖成本。
explanation_cn: distributed OLT deployment 表示分布式 OLT 部署。reuse mobile sites and uplink fiber 表示复用移动站点及上行光纤；在移动通信语境中 mobile sites 通常比 wireless sites 更自然。cost per home passed 是固定宽带建设中“每户覆盖成本”的标准表达。reducing... 用现在分词说明前述复用带来的结果。
source_sentence: OLT分布式部署，复用无线站点与上行光纤，可降低HP成本

examples.en: Distributed OLT deployment can reuse mobile sites and uplink fiber, reducing the cost per home passed.
examples.cn: 分布式 OLT 部署可以复用移动站点和上行光纤，从而降低每户覆盖成本。

examples.en: Reusing existing site infrastructure can reduce fiber deployment costs.
examples.cn: 复用现有站点基础设施可以降低光纤部署成本。

examples.en: The distributed architecture lowers the cost per home passed in low-density areas.
examples.cn: 分布式架构可以降低低密度区域的每户覆盖成本。

pronunciation.text: Distributed OLT deployment can reuse mobile sites and uplink fiber, reducing the cost per home passed.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 distributed OLT deployment、reuse、mobile sites、uplink fiber、reducing 和 cost per home passed；OLT 逐字母读。

source_question: Tigo El Salvador Greenfield FBB ROI with FMC Contribution
core: FMC contribution strengthens the ROI of greenfield FBB investment.
meaning_cn: FMC 贡献能够提升绿区 FBB 投资的回报率。
explanation_cn: FMC contribution 表示融合业务带来的增量贡献；strengthens the ROI of... 比 with FMC contribution 更明确地表达 FMC 对投资回报的正向作用。greenfield FBB investment 表示绿区固定宽带投资。PPT 标题可写为：FMC Contribution Strengthens Greenfield FBB ROI。
source_sentence: Tigo El Salvador Greenfield FBB ROI with FMC Contribution

examples.en: FMC contribution strengthens the ROI of greenfield FBB investment.
examples.cn: FMC 贡献能够提升绿区 FBB 投资的回报率。

examples.en: The ROI model includes both FBB revenue and incremental FMC contribution.
examples.cn: 该 ROI 模型同时纳入 FBB 收入和 FMC 增量贡献。

examples.en: Adding FMC benefits improves the investment case for greenfield expansion.
examples.cn: 纳入 FMC 收益后，绿区扩张的投资逻辑更有吸引力。

pronunciation.text: FMC contribution strengthens the ROI of greenfield FBB investment.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 FMC contribution、strengthens、ROI、greenfield FBB investment；FMC、ROI 和 FBB 逐字母读。

source_question: 考虑先建设10K重叠高价值区域，减少未来竞争风险
core: Prioritize the first 10K homes passed in high-value overlap areas to reduce future competitive risk.
meaning_cn: 优先建设高价值重叠区域的首批 1 万户覆盖，以降低未来竞争风险。
explanation_cn: prioritize the first 10K homes passed 表示优先推进首批 1 万户覆盖；homes passed 是固定宽带建设中的标准覆盖口径。high-value overlap areas 指同时满足高价值和网络重叠条件的区域。to reduce future competitive risk 清楚说明优先建设的战略目的。
source_sentence: 考虑先建设10K重叠高价值区域，减少未来竞争风险

examples.en: Prioritize the first 10K homes passed in high-value overlap areas to reduce future competitive risk.
examples.cn: 优先建设高价值重叠区域的首批 1 万户覆盖，以降低未来竞争风险。

examples.en: The first phase should focus on high-value areas with the greatest competitive exposure.
examples.cn: 第一阶段应聚焦竞争风险最高的高价值区域。

examples.en: A targeted initial build can protect priority areas before competition intensifies.
examples.cn: 有针对性的首期建设可以在竞争加剧前保护重点区域。

pronunciation.text: Prioritize the first 10K homes passed in high-value overlap areas to reduce future competitive risk.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 prioritize、first 10K homes passed、high-value overlap areas、reduce 和 competitive risk；10K 读作 ten K。

source_question: City-Level Data Reveals Three Distinct FMC Growth Zones
core: City-level data reveals three distinct FMC growth zones.
meaning_cn: 城市级数据揭示了三个不同的 FMC 增长区域。
explanation_cn: city-level 作复合形容词修饰 data，需要加连字符。reveals 比 shows 更适合观点型标题，强调数据揭示出的结构性结论。three distinct FMC growth zones 表示三个特征明显不同的融合业务增长区域。PPT 标题可写为：City-Level Data Reveals Three Distinct FMC Growth Zones。
source_sentence: City-Level Data Reveals Three Distinct FMC Growth Zones

examples.en: City-level data reveals three distinct FMC growth zones.
examples.cn: 城市级数据揭示了三个不同的 FMC 增长区域。

examples.en: The analysis identifies three distinct growth zones across the country.
examples.cn: 该分析识别出全国三个不同的增长区域。

examples.en: City-level differences help explain the variation in FMC growth.
examples.cn: 城市层面的差异有助于解释 FMC 增长的不同表现。

pronunciation.text: City-level data reveals three distinct FMC growth zones.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 city-level data、reveals、three distinct、FMC growth zones；FMC 逐字母读。

source_question: 优先考虑这5个省份，占据所有绿区空间的50%
core: Prioritize these five provinces, which account for 50% of all greenfield opportunities.
meaning_cn: 优先考虑这五个省份，它们占全部绿区机会的 50%。
explanation_cn: prioritize these five provinces 表示将这五个省份列为优先区域。which account for... 使用非限制性定语从句补充说明其重要性；account for 表示“占据、构成”。greenfield opportunities 比 greenfield space 更自然地表达可建设或可发展的绿区机会。PPT 中也可写为：Five Priority Provinces Represent 50% of All Greenfield Opportunities。
source_sentence: 优先考虑这5个省份，占据所有绿区空间的50%

examples.en: Prioritize these five provinces, which account for 50% of all greenfield opportunities.
examples.cn: 优先考虑这五个省份，它们占全部绿区机会的 50%。

examples.en: These provinces represent half of the available greenfield opportunity.
examples.cn: 这些省份占可用绿区机会的一半。

examples.en: The first phase should focus on the provinces with the largest addressable opportunity.
examples.cn: 第一阶段应聚焦可开发机会最大的省份。

pronunciation.text: Prioritize these five provinces, which account for 50% of all greenfield opportunities.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 prioritize、five provinces、account for、50 percent、greenfield opportunities。

source_question: Smart Wi-Fi 加速用户精准升套
core: Smart Wi-Fi enables targeted plan upgrades.
meaning_cn: Smart Wi-Fi 能够推动精准的套餐升级。
explanation_cn: enable targeted plan upgrades 表示通过数据洞察或体验能力推动更精准的用户升套。plan upgrade 比 package upgrade 更符合电信套餐语境；targeted 强调针对合适用户和场景，而不是无差别促销。若需要强调商业结果，可写为：Smart Wi-Fi Helps Identify Upgrade Opportunities and Drive Targeted Plan Upgrades。
source_sentence: Smart Wi-Fi 加速用户精准升套

examples.en: Smart Wi-Fi enables targeted plan upgrades.
examples.cn: Smart Wi-Fi 能够推动精准的套餐升级。

examples.en: Usage insights help identify customers with strong upgrade potential.
examples.cn: 使用洞察有助于识别具有较强升套潜力的用户。

examples.en: Targeted plan upgrades can improve ARPU without relying on broad discounts.
examples.cn: 精准升套可以在不依赖大范围折扣的情况下提升 ARPU。

pronunciation.text: Smart Wi-Fi enables targeted plan upgrades.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 Smart Wi-Fi、enables、targeted、plan upgrades；Wi-Fi 读作 why-fye。

source_question: The headline price–speed gap has largely closed；headline是啥意思，能不能换个说法
core: The price–speed gap has largely closed.
meaning_cn: 价格与速率之间的差距已基本缩小。
explanation_cn: price–speed gap 表示不同运营商套餐在价格与速率组合上的差异。has largely closed 表示差距已经明显缩小、接近消失，但不等于完全没有差异。headline 在营销语境中通常指最醒目的主打数字或表层卖点；如果这里只想表达价格—速率差距，直接省略 headline 更清楚。PPT 标题可写为：The Price–Speed Gap Has Largely Closed。
source_sentence: The headline price–speed gap has largely closed.

examples.en: The price–speed gap has largely closed.
examples.cn: 价格与速率之间的差距已基本缩小。

examples.en: Competitors have raised plan speeds, narrowing the price–speed gap.
examples.cn: 竞争对手提高了套餐速率，缩小了价格与速率之间的差距。

examples.en: The remaining difference is no longer large enough to drive customer choice on its own.
examples.cn: 剩余差异已不足以单独驱动客户选择。

pronunciation.text: The price–speed gap has largely closed.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 price–speed gap、largely 和 closed；price–speed 作为复合概念连贯读。

source_question: Cable Color structural edge: all-fiber + symmetric speed
core: Cable Color retains a structural advantage through its all-fiber network and symmetric speeds.
meaning_cn: Cable Color 凭借全光网络和对称速率，仍保持结构性优势。
explanation_cn: retain a structural advantage 表示在表层套餐差距缩小时，仍保有由网络架构决定的长期优势。through its all-fiber network and symmetric speeds 说明优势来源；all-fiber 作复合形容词需要连字符，symmetric speeds 表示上下行速率对称。更短的 PPT 标签可写为：Cable Color’s Structural Edge: All-Fiber and Symmetric Speeds。
source_sentence: Cable Color structural edge: all-fiber + symmetric speed

examples.en: Cable Color retains a structural advantage through its all-fiber network and symmetric speeds.
examples.cn: Cable Color 凭借全光网络和对称速率，仍保持结构性优势。

examples.en: Its all-fiber architecture supports a more consistent customer experience.
examples.cn: 其全光架构能够支持更一致的客户体验。

examples.en: Symmetric speeds remain a meaningful differentiator for upload-intensive use cases.
examples.cn: 对称速率对于上行需求较高的场景仍是有意义的差异点。

pronunciation.text: Cable Color retains a structural advantage through its all-fiber network and symmetric speeds.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 Cable Color、retains、structural advantage、all-fiber network 和 symmetric speeds。
